extracted.name: New Orleans Barbecue Shrimp
extracted.description: Serve this New Orleans BBQ shrimp over pasta, then enjoy with a loaf of French bread and a nice glass of wine. It's a special entrée for family or guests!
ingredient_lines: 1 pound medium shrimp - peeled and deveined
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, stir together garlic powder, onion powder, basil, thyme, rosemary, cayenne pepper, and paprika.

Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add shrimp and cook for a couple of minutes. Season with spice mixture and continue to cook and stir for a few minutes. Add beer and Worcestershire sauce; simmer until shrimp are cooked through, about 1 more minute. Taste and season with salt before serving.
